scripts.backend:dev: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend uvicorn lifegoods.main:app --app-dir backend/src --reload
scripts.backend:test: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests
scripts.backend:lint: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend ruff check backend/src backend/tests backend/scripts backend/migrations
scripts.db:migrate: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.api:generate: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend python backend/scripts/export_openapi.py && pnpm --dir frontend api:generate
scripts.api:check: pnpm api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/openapi.json frontend/src/api/generated
